I am an old woman, I never went to school, but I have grown rice many seasons on this land that belongs to my family. This year I will put a little fertilizer because rice without fertilizer gives very small grains, but I cannot buy much — maybe one bag of urea and one bag of NPK for the whole plot, that is what my cash allows. I will keep my own seed from last harvest like my mother taught me, and my children and I will do most of the work ourselves, only hiring a few young men from the village for transplanting and harvest when the work is too heavy.
